title: Card
description: Frames related content such as a product or an order, with header, title, description, action, image, content and footer parts.

components.Card: Groups related content, such as a product or an order, into one framed block.
components.CardAction: Holds a control placed at the end of the card header.
components.CardContent: Holds the main content of the card.
components.CardDescription: Shows secondary text below the card title.
components.CardFooter: Holds the closing content of the card, such as status or buttons.
components.CardHeader: Groups the title, description and action at the top of the card.
components.CardImage: Shows a picture across the top of the card.
components.CardTitle: Names what the card is about.
